reasons.components.base: Qwen-Image-2512, Apache-2.0 at a pinned revision, accepted 2026-09-17 (licence matrix section 12)
reasons.components.control: the Fun union control trained for Qwen-Image-2512 (the 2602 release), Apache-2.0; the InstantX union control was trained for the original Qwen-Image
reasons.sampler.control_context_scale_milli: 0.80, VideoX-Fun's example value, inside the 0.70 to 0.95 range the control's card recommends for stronger control and detail
reasons.sampler.guidance_milli: 4.0, the true classifier-free guidance VideoX-Fun's Qwen control example uses
reasons.sampler.height: 512, small and fast for a smoke test
reasons.sampler.name: the flow-match Euler scheduler the base repository ships and VideoX-Fun's own example selects
reasons.sampler.negative_prompt: a single space, which is what enables true classifier-free guidance in this pipeline without describing anything
reasons.sampler.steps: 8 steps at 512 by 512: a smoke test that the backend loads, tiles and decodes, cheaply, before the session's own settings run
reasons.sampler.tiling: the lane's tiling schedule: the latent grid and the control latents are rolled by a seeded offset each step and rolled back, because a transformer model has no convolution padding to make periodic
reasons.sampler.width: 512, small and fast for a smoke test
reasons.sampler.wrap_margin_px: 64 px, eight latent pixels of the neighbouring tile given to the VAE on each side and cropped after, so its convolutions see the tile's other edge instead of zeros
reasons.seconds_per_image: 20 s for 8 steps at 512 by 512, ESTIMATED

targets.prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Orthographic photograph, taken straight on, of red to brown fired clay brick in running bond, 215 by 65 mm faces with 10 mm recessed joints, 1800 mm across, weathered by years of city street rain: soot and grime collected in the joints, faint vertical rain streaks below where sills would sit, a few patches of pale efflorescence. Flat even overcast light with no shadows, no highlights and no vignetting. The whole frame is the surface: no windows, no doors, no signs, no text, no people, no sky, no horizon.

reasons.conditioning.depth: the set's own height map: the recipe's exact relief, which the model must keep
reasons.prompt: the set's own summary from its container header and its extent from the texture manifest, a weathering description in plain words, and the constraints that keep the picture a texture: flat light so no lighting is baked into a base colour, and nothing structural the recipe does not hold
